meta.name: Feed-built campaign

stages.name: Reconnaissance
stages.narrative: an outside host probes the company's web server and domain names

stages.name: Resource Development
stages.narrative: the workstation contacts attacker-prepared infrastructure: a fresh domain and a self-signed server

stages.name: Initial Access
stages.narrative: a user on the compromised workstation is lured to a credential-harvesting page

stages.name: Execution
stages.narrative: the payload is fetched and runs on the workstation

stages.name: Persistence
stages.narrative: the operator sets up a scheduled task and a service so the access survives a reboot

stages.name: Command And Control
stages.narrative: the implant checks in with its command-and-control infrastructure

stages.name: Privilege Escalation
stages.narrative: the operator edits a group policy and adds an account to a privileged group

stages.name: Defense Impairment
stages.narrative: security services are stopped and the vendor update host is blocked

stages.name: Stealth
stages.narrative: the operator clears the event log and fetches a file with a signed system component

stages.name: Discovery
stages.narrative: the operator maps the directory, shares and services around the workstation

stages.name: Credential Access
stages.narrative: the operator requests service tickets and tries passwords against exposed services

stages.name: Lateral Movement
stages.narrative: the operator moves from the workstation to a server

stages.name: Collection
stages.narrative: the operator reads large result sets from a database and stages an archive on a server

stages.name: Exfiltration
stages.narrative: collected data leaves the network to an attacker-controlled host

stages.name: Impact
stages.narrative: files on a share are mass-renamed, the pattern ransomware leaves on the wire
